mode: interactive TUI, --no-daemon, isolated CODEX_HOME, loopback fixture Responses endpoint returning one request_user_input function call
note: Field names and relative timing are actual. Session/turn IDs, paths, prompts and tool payloads are omitted; tool_use_id is the fixture endpoint's synthetic call_id.

planMode.entry: User typed `/plan <prompt>` in the TUI; collaboration_mode.mode was plan.

defaultModeRejected.entry: Default collaboration mode. The tool output was `request_user_input is unavailable in Default mode`; no dialog was shown.

findings: Unlike Claude, Codex emits no PermissionRequest for request_user_input; the question dialog was open ~17 s with no intermediate hook.
The answered question resolves with PostToolUse carrying the original tool_use_id, followed by Stop.
A Default-mode rejection emits PreToolUse(request_user_input) and then Stop without PostToolUse, so a hook-only Question wait is created for a dialog that never appears and is cleared only by Stop.
Initial CLI prompt text beginning with /plan is sent to the model as plain text and does not enter Plan mode.
